description: Post-KBR-5 positive control: a system prompt over the window plus an ordinary user turn compacts normally, without raising
origin_note: Synthetic, not captured: a system prompt alone over the window does not occur in a real Claude Code session on demand. The size is constructed: a small hand-written core padded with deterministic filler past the window. Recorded as the KBR-5 correction asks: this shape compacts normally (the guaranteed-fit fallback keeps the user turn), so it is the complement of the compaction-failure path, not a recovery fixture. The mandatory human-review step is replaced by code-review of the builder (this script), the scrubber's full-byte scan in CI, and a bounded head/tail human read of the committed .body file, per TEST_SUITE.md section 7.1.1.
